tickets.summary: Customer reports two $49 charges for the same monthly subscription and requests reversal of the duplicate.
tickets.recommended_action: Review the subscription billing records, confirm whether the two $49 charges are duplicates, and reverse the duplicate charge if verified.
tickets.source_evidence: “charged $49 twice for the same monthly subscription this morning”

tickets.summary: Customer cannot sign in because multiple password-reset requests have not produced a reset email.
tickets.recommended_action: Investigate password-reset email delivery, verify whether the requests were generated, and help restore account access.
tickets.source_evidence: “no reset email has arrived” and “I cannot sign in to my account”

tickets.summary: After the latest app update, the mobile app closes when uploading JPG files larger than 5 MB; desktop upload still works.
tickets.recommended_action: Reproduce the issue on the updated mobile app with a JPG larger than 5 MB, investigate the crash, and note the desktop-site workaround.
tickets.source_evidence: “uploading a JPG larger than 5 MB closes the mobile app”

tickets.summary: Customer requests a dark mode to make the interface easier to use at night; existing functionality works.
tickets.recommended_action: Record and route the dark-mode request to the product team for consideration.
tickets.source_evidence: “Could you add a dark mode?” and “everything else is working”

tickets.summary: All 35 agents in a production workspace receive 503 errors after sign-in, stopping the entire team's work.
tickets.recommended_action: Escalate as a production incident, investigate the workspace-wide 503 errors immediately, and verify whether the public status page needs updating.
tickets.source_evidence: “All 35 agents” receive “a 503 error” and “Work has stopped”

tickets.summary: Customer can see last month's invoice number but cannot find a way to download the invoice as a PDF.
tickets.recommended_action: Provide the correct steps or location for downloading the invoice PDF, or investigate why the export option is unavailable.
tickets.source_evidence: “cannot find an export button” for “last month's invoice as a PDF”

tickets.summary: The analytics dashboard intermittently times out and takes about a minute per attempt, though retrying usually succeeds.
tickets.recommended_action: Investigate intermittent dashboard timeouts and slow load times, using the reported repeated occurrences and successful retry behavior.
tickets.source_evidence: “timed out three times today” and “Retrying usually loads it”

tickets.summary: Customer was charged again after support confirmed cancellation and requests a refund and prevention of future charges.
tickets.recommended_action: Verify the confirmed cancellation, stop any active recurring billing, and refund the post-cancellation charge if validated.
tickets.source_evidence: “Support confirmed my cancellation last month, but I was charged again today”

tickets.summary: Customer praises the new dashboard and suggests a weekly email digest containing the same metrics.
tickets.recommended_action: Record and route the weekly metrics email-digest suggestion to the product team for consideration.
tickets.source_evidence: “The new dashboard is excellent” and requests “A weekly email digest”

tickets.summary: Customer reports that something is not working but provides no affected feature, symptoms, or context.
tickets.recommended_action: Ask which feature or task is failing, what happened, what was expected, any error message, reproduction steps, and the device or environment used.
